methods.name: startDownload
methods.description: Starts a download of the given URL.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The URL of the resource to download.

methods.name: cancelDownload
methods.description: Cancels an active download by its ID.

parameters.name: downloadId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the download.

methods.name: pauseDownload
methods.description: Pauses an active download by its ID.

parameters.name: downloadId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the download.

methods.name: resumeDownload
methods.description: Resumes a paused download by its ID.

parameters.name: downloadId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the download.

methods.name: isDownloadPaused
methods.description: Checks if a download is currently paused.

parameters.name: downloadId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the download.
